# 0002: Data layer

**Status:** Accepted. Not yet implemented.

**Context.** The product has relational data: studios, members, clients, projects, proposals, scope items, milestones, payments, change requests, files and an audit trail. Payments and sign-offs need transactions and an audit history. The app runs on serverless functions, so connection pooling matters.

**Decision.** PostgreSQL with **Drizzle ORM**, versioned migrations generated by `drizzle-kit`. Use a pooled connection string suited to serverless (transaction pooling) for the app and a direct connection for migrations.

**Why Drizzle over Prisma.** Drizzle is SQL-first, has a smaller runtime with no separate engine binary, and cold-starts better on serverless. The team can read the SQL it generates.

**Consequences.** All queries go through Drizzle. No raw string SQL. Every query path needs an index, and cursor pagination is the default. Seed scripts live in `db/seed` and never run against production.
